title: Blocked In Hardcore
description: A challenging version of the Blocked In datapack
body:
This is an extra spicy version of Blocked In. Your health is tied to achievment points and you only get three lives. An extra recipie has been added to replentish lives but do so at your own risk! Rewards have been halved so you get even less space to move around and build.
If you are the type of person that enjoys a hard challenge then this is for you!
If not....maybe try the original Blocked In.

A world bending datapack that sees you trapped in a small worldborder by a crazed AI.
Complete tasks or eat delicious soup to expand your world.



Blocked in adds a layer of complexity to your vannila minecraft world.
Start your new world with this pack and you will be greeted by an AI datapack who has trapped you in a 5x5 box.

Using the hints left by the Datapack creator you can expand the area in which you are trapped.
Glitch storms will happen naturaly or have a chance of happening after you sleep. These will temporaraly shut down the AI allowing you to explore the world freely and gather loot. Just dont stay out too long!

There are 14 new recipies added to the game with powerful effects.
The world generation has been altered for smaller biomes making it easier to explore.

I hope you enjoy this chalenge!
This Pack can be added to other packs for even more challenges!

High performance! No running tick functions.

Notes: please ingnore the outdated datapack warning it will work.
If you start in an ocean or inside a mountain...just start a new world! Or don't...I'm not your mum.
If running on a server: be aware that the world boarder shrinks to 5x5 area when no players are connected. So maybe do a /worldboarder set (number) in server commands before joining after a server restart.

That is all :) have a great day.
